تستهلكون (form X)
# تَسْتَهْلِكُونَ (tastahlikūna) /tas.tah.li.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# تُسْتَهْلَكُونَ (tustahlakūna) /tus.tah.la.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
